title: पञ्चाशीतितमोऽध्यायः

summary.en: Vasishtha tells Rama of the sight of Brahma he had heard of, and of how Agni, the carrier of offerings, brought forward the seed. Gold is called the first of the jewels and the purest of purifiers, born of Agni and of the Lord, and Vasishtha tells Rama to give gold to brahmins and be freed from sin.
summary.kn: ವಸಿಷ್ಠ ರಾಮನಿಗೆ ಬ್ರಹ್ಮದರ್ಶನದ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ಕೇಳಿದುದನ್ನು, ಹವ್ಯವಾಹಕ ಅಗ್ನಿ ವೀರ್ಯ ತಂದುದನ್ನು ಹೇಳುತ್ತಾನೆ. ಚಿನ್ನ ರತ್ನಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಮೊದಲು, ಪವಿತ್ರಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಪವಿತ್ರ, ಅಗ್ನಿ-ಈಶ್ವರರಿಂದ ಹುಟ್ಟಿದುದು, ಬ್ರಾಹ್ಮಣರಿಗೆ ಚಿನ್ನ ದಾನ ಮಾಡಿ ಪಾಪ ಕಳೆಯಲು ರಾಮನಿಗೆ ಹೇಳುತ್ತಾನೆ.
summary.hi: वसिष्ठ राम से ब्रह्मदर्शन की सुनी बात और हव्यवाहक अग्नि के वीर्य लाने की कथा कहते हैं। सोना रत्नों में प्रथम और पवित्रों में पवित्र, अग्नि और ईश्वर से उत्पन्न कहा गया है, और वसिष्ठ राम को ब्राह्मणों को सोना देकर पाप से मुक्त होने को कहते हैं।
summary.te: వసిష్ఠుడు రామునికి బ్రహ్మ దర్శనం గురించి విన్నదాన్ని, హవ్యవాహకుడైన అగ్ని వీర్యాన్ని తెచ్చిన తీరును చెబుతాడు. బంగారం రత్నాలలో మొదటిదని, పవిత్రాలలో పవిత్రమైనదని, అగ్ని, ఈశ్వరుల నుండి పుట్టినదని, బ్రాహ్మణులకు బంగారం దానం చేసి పాపం నుండి విముక్తి పొందమని రామునికి చెబుతాడు.
summary.ta: வசிஷ்டர் ராமனுக்குப் பிரம்மதரிசனம் பற்றிக் கேட்டதையும் அவியைச் சுமக்கும் அக்னி வித்தைக் கொண்டுவந்ததையும் கூறுகிறார். பொன் ரத்தினங்களில் முதன்மையானது, தூய்மைகளில் தூய்மையானது, அக்னியும் இறைவனும் தந்தது, அந்தணருக்குப் பொன் தந்து பாவம் நீங்கு என்று ராமனிடம் கூறுகிறார்.
summary.ml: ബ്രഹ്മാവിനെ കണ്ടതിനെക്കുറിച്ച് താൻ കേട്ട കഥ വസിഷ്ഠൻ രാമനോട് പറയുന്നു; യാഗവാഹകനായ അഗ്നി ബീജം മുന്നോട്ടുകൊണ്ടുവന്നതെങ്ങനെയെന്നും അദ്ദേഹം പറയുന്നു. രത്നങ്ങളിൽ ഒന്നാമനും ശുദ്ധീകരണങ്ങളിൽ ഏറ്റവും ശുദ്ധവുമായ സ്വർണ്ണം അഗ്നിയിലും ഭഗവാനിലും ജനിച്ചതെന്ന് പറയപ്പെടുന്നു; പാപത്തിൽനിന്ന് മോചിതനാകാൻ ബ്രാഹ്മണർക്ക് സ്വർണ്ണം ദാനം ചെയ്യണമെന്ന് വസിഷ്ഠൻ രാമനോട് പറയുന്നു.

source: Mahabharata, Critical Edition (BORI, Pune) 13.85; e-text by M. Tokunaga and J. D. Smith, © BORI 1999, version of Tue Nov 03 2026

verses.text: वसिष्ठ उवाच

meaning.en: Vasishtha said:

verses.text:
अपि चेदं पुरा राम श्रुतं मे ब्रह्मदर्शनम् ।
पितामहस्य यद्वृत्तं ब्रह्मणः परमात्मनः ॥

meaning.en: Rama, long ago I also heard this vision of Brahma, what happened to the grandsire Brahma, the supreme self.

verses.text:
देवस्य महतस्तात वारुणीं बिभ्रतस्तनुम् ।
ऐश्वर्ये वारुणे राम रुद्रस्येशस्य वै प्रभो ॥

meaning.en: Dear one, when the great god took on the form of Varuna, in Varuna's lordship, Rama, the lord Rudra,

verses.text:
आजग्मुर्मुनयः सर्वे देवाश्चाग्निपुरोगमाः ।
यज्ञाङ्गानि च सर्वाणि वषट्कारश्च मूर्तिमान् ॥

meaning.en: all the sages and the gods led by Agni came, and all the limbs of sacrifice, and the vashat cry in bodily form.

verses.text:
मूर्तिमन्ति च सामानि यजूंषि च सहस्रशः ।
ऋग्वेदश्चागमत्तत्र पदक्रमविभूषितः ॥

meaning.en: The Samas and Yajus in thousands came in bodies, and the Rigveda came there adorned with its pada and krama recitations.

verses.text:
लक्षणानि स्वराः स्तोभा निरुक्तं स्वरभक्तयः ।
ओंकारश्चावसन्नेत्रे निग्रहप्रग्रहौ तथा ॥

meaning.en: The marks, the accents, the stobha syllables, the Nirukta, the divisions of accent, the Omkara, and the rules of restraint and holding all dwelt at the sacrifice.

verses.text:
वेदाश्च सोपनिषदो विद्या सावित्र्यथापि च ।
भूतं भव्यं भविष्यच्च दधार भगवाञ्शिवः ।
जुह्वच्चात्मन्यथात्मानं स्वयमेव तदा प्रभो ॥

meaning.en: The Vedas with their Upanishads, knowledge, and Savitri were there. The blessed Shiva held the past, present and future, and himself offered himself into himself.

verses.text:
देवपत्न्यश्च कन्याश्च देवानां चैव मातरः ।
आजग्मुः सहितास्तत्र तदा भृगुकुलोद्वह ॥

meaning.en: Wives of the gods, maidens, and mothers of the gods all came together there, O descendant of Bhrigu's line.

verses.text:
यज्ञं पशुपतेः प्रीता वरुणस्य महात्मनः ।
स्वयंभुवस्तु ता दृष्ट्वा रेतः समपतद्भुवि ॥

meaning.en: Delighted at the sacrifice of the great-souled Varuna, lord of cattle, when the self-born one saw those women, his seed fell on the earth.

verses.text:
तस्य शुक्रस्य निष्पन्दात्पांसून्संगृह्य भूमितः ।
प्रास्यत्पूषा कराभ्यां वै तस्मिन्नेव हुताशने ॥

meaning.en: Pushan, gathering the dust of the earth drenched with that seed, threw it with both hands into that very fire.

verses.text:
ततस्तस्मिन्संप्रवृत्ते सत्रे ज्वलितपावके ।
ब्रह्मणो जुह्वतस्तत्र प्रादुर्भावो बभूव ह ॥

meaning.en: Then, as the sacrificial session proceeded with the fire blazing, a manifestation arose from Brahma as he offered there.

verses.text:
स्कन्नमात्रं च तच्छुक्रं स्रुवेण प्रतिगृह्य सः ।
आज्यवन्मन्त्रवच्चापि सोऽजुहोद्भृगुनन्दन ॥

meaning.en: He took that seed, just fallen, with the ladle, and offered it like ghee, with mantras, descendant of Bhrigu.

verses.text:
ततः संजनयामास भूतग्रामं स वीर्यवान् ।
ततस्तु तेजसस्तस्माज्जज्ञे लोकेषु तैजसम् ॥

meaning.en: Then the mighty one brought forth the host of beings; and from that energy was born what is of energy in the worlds.

verses.text:
तमसस्तामसा भावा व्यापि सत्त्वं तथोभयम् ।
सगुणस्तेजसो नित्यं तमस्याकाशमेव च ॥

meaning.en: From darkness arose states of darkness, and from goodness what pervades; and the two together. The one with qualities arose always from energy, and space from darkness.

verses.text:
सर्वभूतेष्वथ तथा सत्त्वं तेजस्तथा तमः ।
शुक्रे हुतेऽग्नौ तस्मिंस्तु प्रादुरासंस्त्रयः प्रभो ॥

meaning.en: In all beings are goodness, energy and darkness. When the seed was offered in that fire, lord, three appeared.

verses.text:
पुरुषा वपुषा युक्ता युक्ताः प्रसवजैर्गुणैः ।
भृगित्येव भृगुः पूर्वमङ्गारेभ्योऽङ्गिराभवत् ॥

meaning.en: They were persons endowed with bodies and the qualities born of their birth. First Bhrigu, by the sound 'bhrig', was Bhrigu; Angiras came from the embers.

verses.text:
अङ्गारसंश्रयाच्चैव कविरित्यपरोऽभवत् ।
सह ज्वालाभिरुत्पन्नो भृगुस्तस्माद्भृगुः स्मृतः ॥

meaning.en: By taking refuge in the embers another arose, Kavi. Bhrigu was born with the flames, therefore he is remembered as Bhrigu.

verses.text:
मरीचिभ्यो मरीचिस्तु मारीचः कश्यपो ह्यभूत् ।
अङ्गारेभ्योऽङ्गिरास्तात वालखिल्याः शिलोच्चयात् ।
अत्रैवात्रेति च विभो जातमत्रिं वदन्त्यपि ॥

meaning.en: From the rays came Marichi, and from Marichi, Kashyapa, Marichi's son. From the embers, dear one, came Angiras; from a heap of stones the Valakhilyas. And just here, lord, they say Atri was born.

verses.text:
तथा भस्मव्यपोहेभ्यो ब्रह्मर्षिगणसंमिताः ।
वैखानसाः समुत्पन्नास्तपःश्रुतगुणेप्सवः ।
अश्रुतोऽस्य समुत्पन्नावश्विनौ रूपसंमतौ ॥

meaning.en: Likewise from the clearings of ash arose the Vaikhanasas, equal to hosts of brahmin sages, who sought austerity, learning and virtue. From his unheard came the two Ashvins, esteemed for their beauty.

verses.text:
शेषाः प्रजानां पतयः स्रोतोभ्यस्तस्य जज्ञिरे ।
ऋषयो लोमकूपेभ्यः स्वेदाच्छन्दो मलात्मकम् ॥

meaning.en: The remaining lords of creatures were born from his streams, the sages from the pores of his hair, and from his sweat the metres, made of impurity.

verses.text:
एतस्मात्कारणादाहुरग्निं सर्वास्तु देवताः ।
ऋषयः श्रुतसंपन्ना वेदप्रामाण्यदर्शनात् ॥

meaning.en: For this reason the learned sages, seeing the authority of the Veda, call Agni all the gods.

verses.text:
यानि दारूणि ते मासा निर्यासाः पक्षसंज्ञिताः ।
अहोरात्रा मुहूर्तास्तु पित्तं ज्योतिश्च वारुणम् ॥

meaning.en: The logs of wood are the months, the saps are called the fortnights, the days and nights and the moments are bile, and the radiance is Varuna's.

verses.text:
रौद्रं लोहितमित्याहुर्लोहितात्कनकं स्मृतम् ।
तन्मैत्रमिति विज्ञेयं धूमाच्च वसवः स्मृताः ॥

meaning.en: They call the red Rudra's; from the red, gold is remembered, and that is to be known as Mitra's; and from smoke the Vasus are remembered.

verses.text:
अर्चिषो याश्च ते रुद्रास्तथादित्या महाप्रभाः ।
उद्दिष्टास्ते तथाङ्गारा ये धिष्ण्येषु दिवि स्थिताः ॥

meaning.en: Those that are the flames are the Rudras and the very radiant Adityas; the embers are described as those that stand in the hearths in heaven.

verses.text:
आदिनाथश्च लोकस्य तत्परं ब्रह्म तद्ध्रुवम् ।
सर्वकामदमित्याहुस्तत्र हव्यमुदावहत् ॥

meaning.en: He is the first lord of the world, that supreme Brahman, the fixed; they say it grants all desires, and there he carried the oblation.

verses.text:
ततोऽब्रवीन्महादेवो वरुणः परमात्मकः ।
मम सत्रमिदं दिव्यमहं गृहपतिस्त्विह ॥

meaning.en: Then the great god Varuna, whose self is supreme, said: 'This divine sacrificial session is mine, and here I am the master of the house.

verses.text:
त्रीणि पूर्वाण्यपत्यानि मम तानि न संशयः ।
इति जानीत खगमा मम यज्ञफलं हि तत् ॥

meaning.en: Those three first children are mine, without doubt. Know this, you who move in the sky: it is the fruit of my sacrifice.'

verses.text: अग्निरुवाच

meaning.en: Agni said:

verses.text:
मदङ्गेभ्यः प्रसूतानि मदाश्रयकृतानि च ।
ममैव तान्यपत्यानि वरुणो ह्यवशात्मकः ॥

meaning.en: 'They were born from my limbs and made by taking shelter in me. They are my children alone; Varuna is not in control of himself.'

verses.text:
अथाब्रवील्लोकगुरुर्ब्रह्मा लोकपितामहः ।
ममैव तान्यपत्यानि मम शुक्रं हुतं हि तत् ॥

meaning.en: Then Brahma, teacher of the world and grandsire of the world, said, 'They are my children alone, for that seed was offered by me.

verses.text:
अहं वक्ता च मन्त्रस्य होता शुक्रस्य चैव ह ।
यस्य बीजं फलं तस्य शुक्रं चेत्कारणं मतम् ॥

meaning.en: I am the speaker of the mantra and the offerer of the seed. If the seed is the cause, then the fruit belongs to whose seed it is.'

verses.text:
ततोऽब्रुवन्देवगणाः पितामहमुपेत्य वै ।
कृताञ्जलिपुटाः सर्वे शिरोभिरभिवन्द्य च ॥

meaning.en: Then the hosts of gods approached the grandsire, joined their palms, bowed their heads, and said:

verses.text:
वयं च भगवन्सर्वे जगच्च सचराचरम् ।
तवैव प्रसवाः सर्वे तस्मादग्निर्विभावसुः ।
वरुणश्चेश्वरो देवो लभतां काममीप्सितम् ॥

meaning.en: 'Blessed one, we all and the world with its moving and unmoving things are all your offspring. Therefore let Agni Vibhavasu and the lord Varuna each have the desire he wishes.'

verses.text:
निसर्गाद्वरुणश्चापि ब्रह्मणो यादसां पतिः ।
जग्राह वै भृगुं पूर्वमपत्यं सूर्यवर्चसम् ॥

meaning.en: By nature Varuna, lord of water creatures, took first Bhrigu as Brahma's child, bright as the sun.

verses.text:
ईश्वरोऽङ्गिरसं चाग्नेरपत्यार्थेऽभ्यकल्पयत् ।
पितामहस्त्वपत्यं वै कविं जग्राह तत्त्ववित् ॥

meaning.en: The lord assigned Angiras to be Agni's child, and the grandsire, knowing the truth, took Kavi as his child.

verses.text:
तदा स वारुणः ख्यातो भृगुः प्रसवकर्मकृत् ।
आग्नेयस्त्वङ्गिराः श्रीमान्कविर्ब्राह्मो महायशाः ।
भार्गवाङ्गिरसौ लोके लोकसंतानलक्षणौ ॥

meaning.en: Then Bhrigu, who did the work of procreation, was known as Varuna's. Angiras, glorious, was Agni's, and Kavi, greatly famed, Brahma's. Bhargava and Angirasa are the signs in the world of the continuity of the world.

verses.text:
एते विप्रवराः सर्वे प्रजानां पतयस्त्रयः ।
सर्वं संतानमेतेषामिदमित्युपधारय ॥

meaning.en: These best of brahmins are the three lords of creatures; understand that all this lineage is theirs.

verses.text:
भृगोस्तु पुत्रास्तत्रासन्सप्त तुल्या भृगोर्गुणैः ।
च्यवनो वज्रशीर्षश्च शुचिरौर्वस्तथैव च ॥

meaning.en: Bhrigu had seven sons equal to Bhrigu in virtues: Chyavana, Vajrashirsha, Shuchi, and Aurva,

verses.text:
शुक्रो वरेण्यश्च विभुः सवनश्चेति सप्त ते ।
भार्गवा वारुणाः सर्वे येषां वंशे भवानपि ॥

meaning.en: Shukra, Varenya, Vibhu and Savana, these seven. All the Bhargavas are Varuna's, and you too are in their line.

verses.text:
अष्टौ चाङ्गिरसः पुत्रा वारुणास्तेऽप्युदाहृताः ।
बृहस्पतिरुतथ्यश्च वयस्यः शान्तिरेव च ॥

meaning.en: Angiras had eight sons, who too are called Varuna's: Brihaspati, Utathya, Vayasya and Shanti,

verses.text:
घोरो विरूपः संवर्तः सुधन्वा चाष्टमः स्मृतः ।
एतेऽष्टावग्निजाः सर्वे ज्ञाननिष्ठा निरामयाः ॥

meaning.en: Ghora, Virupa, Samvarta, and Sudhanva is remembered as the eighth. These eight, born of Agni, are all devoted to knowledge and free of ills.

verses.text:
ब्राह्मणस्य कवेः पुत्रा वारुणास्तेऽप्युदाहृताः ।
अष्टौ प्रसवजैर्युक्ता गुणैर्ब्रह्मविदः शुभाः ॥

meaning.en: The sons of Kavi, Brahma's, are also called Varuna's. Eight of them, endowed with the qualities of their birth, are knowers of Brahman and auspicious.

verses.text:
कविः काव्यश्च विष्णुश्च बुद्धिमानुशनास्तथा ।
भृगुश्च विरजाश्चैव काशी चोग्रश्च धर्मवित् ॥

meaning.en: Kavi, Kavya, Vishnu, the wise Ushanas, Bhrigu, Viraja, Kashi, and the dharma-knowing Ugra.

verses.text:
अष्टौ कविसुता ह्येते सर्वमेभिर्जगत्ततम् ।
प्रजापतय एते हि प्रजानां यैरिमाः प्रजाः ॥

meaning.en: These are the eight sons of Kavi; the whole world is spread by them. They are the lords of creatures, by whom these creatures exist.

verses.text:
एवमङ्गिरसश्चैव कवेश्च प्रसवान्वयैः ।
भृगोश्च भृगुशार्दूल वंशजैः सततं जगत् ॥

meaning.en: So, tiger of the Bhrigus, the world is ever continued by the descendants of Angiras and of Kavi and by the descendants of Bhrigu.

verses.text:
वरुणश्चादितो विप्र जग्राह प्रभुरीश्वरः ।
कविं तात भृगुं चैव तस्मात्तौ वारुणौ स्मृतौ ॥

meaning.en: Brahmin, the lord Varuna took Kavi and Bhrigu at the start, therefore those two are remembered as Varuna's.

verses.text:
जग्राहाङ्गिरसं देवः शिखी तस्माद्धुताशनः ।
तस्मादङ्गिरसो ज्ञेयाः सर्व एव तदन्वयाः ॥

meaning.en: The god with the crest, Agni, took Angiras, therefore all Angirases and their line are to be known as his.

verses.text:
ब्रह्मा पितामहः पूर्वं देवताभिः प्रसादितः ।
इमे नः संतरिष्यन्ति प्रजाभिर्जगदीश्वराः ॥

meaning.en: Long ago the grandsire Brahma was propitiated by the gods: 'These lords of the world will carry us across with their offspring.

verses.text:
सर्वे प्रजानां पतयः सर्वे चातितपस्विनः ।
त्वत्प्रसादादिमं लोकं तारयिष्यन्ति शाश्वतम् ॥

meaning.en: All of them are lords of creatures and all great ascetics. By your favour they will carry this eternal world across.

verses.text:
तथैव वंशकर्तारस्तव तेजोविवर्धनाः ।
भवेयुर्वेदविदुषः सर्वे वाक्पतयस्तथा ॥

meaning.en: So too may the founders of the line, who increase your radiance, all be knowers of the Veda and lords of speech.

verses.text:
देवपक्षधराः सौम्याः प्राजापत्या महर्षयः ।
आप्नुवन्ति तपश्चैव ब्रह्मचर्यं परं तथा ॥

meaning.en: Holding the gods' side, gentle, belonging to Prajapati, the great sages attain austerity and supreme celibacy.

verses.text:
सर्वे हि वयमेते च तवैव प्रसवः प्रभो ।
देवानां ब्राह्मणानां च त्वं हि कर्ता पितामह ॥

meaning.en: Lord, we all and these are your offspring alone. Grandsire, you are the maker of gods and brahmins.

verses.text:
मरीचिमादितः कृत्वा सर्वे चैवाथ भार्गवाः ।
अपत्यानीति संप्रेक्ष्य क्षमयाम पितामह ॥

meaning.en: Taking Marichi first, and all the Bhargavas, and looking on them as your children, we ask your pardon, grandsire.

verses.text:
ते त्वनेनैव रूपेण प्रजनिष्यन्ति वै प्रजाः ।
स्थापयिष्यन्ति चात्मानं युगादिनिधने तथा ॥

meaning.en: In this very form they will beget creatures and will establish themselves at the beginning and end of an age.'

verses.text:
एवमेतत्पुरा वृत्तं तस्य यज्ञे महात्मनः ।
देवश्रेष्ठस्य लोकादौ वारुणीं बिभ्रतस्तनुम् ॥

meaning.en: So it happened long ago at the sacrifice of that great one, best of gods, at the beginning of the world, when he took on Varuna's form.

verses.text:
अग्निर्ब्रह्मा पशुपतिः शर्वो रुद्रः प्रजापतिः ।
अग्नेरपत्यमेतद्वै सुवर्णमिति धारणा ॥

meaning.en: Agni, Brahma, Pashupati, Sharva, Rudra and Prajapati: the belief is that gold is Agni's offspring.

verses.text:
अग्न्यभावे च कुर्वन्ति वह्निस्थानेषु काञ्चनम् ।
जामदग्न्य प्रमाणज्ञा वेदश्रुतिनिदर्शनात् ॥

meaning.en: In the absence of fire they put gold in the fire's places. Jamadagni's son, you who know the authorities, this is shown by Vedic scripture.

verses.text:
कुशस्तम्बे जुहोत्यग्निं सुवर्णं तत्र संस्थितम् ।
हुते प्रीतिकरीमृद्धिं भगवांस्तत्र मन्यते ॥

meaning.en: One offers into the fire on a tuft of kusha grass where gold is placed; the lord considers the offering made thereby to bring pleasing prosperity.

verses.text:
तस्मादग्निपराः सर्वा देवता इति शुश्रुम ।
ब्रह्मणो हि प्रसूतोऽग्निरग्नेरपि च काञ्चनम् ॥

meaning.en: Therefore we have heard that all the gods have Agni as their chief. Agni was born from Brahma, and gold from Agni.

verses.text:
तस्माद्ये वै प्रयच्छन्ति सुवर्णं धर्मदर्शिनः ।
देवतास्ते प्रयच्छन्ति समस्ता इति नः श्रुतम् ॥

meaning.en: Therefore, we have heard, those who see dharma and give gold give all the gods.

verses.text:
तस्य चातमसो लोका गच्छतः परमां गतिम् ।
स्वर्लोके राजराज्येन सोऽभिषिच्येत भार्गव ॥

meaning.en: For one going to the highest goal, the worlds are free of darkness; he is anointed in heaven with the kingship of kings, O Bhargava.

verses.text:
आदित्योदयने प्राप्ते विधिमन्त्रपुरस्कृतम् ।
ददाति काञ्चनं यो वै दुःस्वप्नं प्रतिहन्ति सः ॥

meaning.en: One who at sunrise gives gold, preceded by rule and mantra, destroys a bad dream.

verses.text:
ददात्युदितमात्रे यस्तस्य पाप्मा विधूयते ।
मध्याह्ने ददतो रुक्मं हन्ति पापमनागतम् ॥

meaning.en: One who gives it just after sunrise has his sin shaken off; giving gold at midday he destroys sin not yet come.

verses.text:
ददाति पश्चिमां संध्यां यः सुवर्णं धृतव्रतः ।
ब्रह्मवाय्वग्निसोमानां सालोक्यमुपयाति सः ॥

meaning.en: One of firm vow who gives gold at the evening twilight attains sharing the worlds of Brahma, Vayu, Agni and Soma.

verses.text:
सेन्द्रेषु चैव लोकेषु प्रतिष्ठां प्राप्नुते शुभाम् ।
इह लोके यशः प्राप्य शान्तपाप्मा प्रमोदते ॥

meaning.en: He gains an auspicious standing in the worlds with Indra, and having gained fame in this world, with sin quieted, he rejoices.

verses.text:
ततः संपद्यतेऽन्येषु लोकेष्वप्रतिमः सदा ।
अनावृतगतिश्चैव कामचारी भवत्युत ॥

meaning.en: Then in other worlds he is always unmatched, and his movement is unobstructed and he goes at will.

verses.text:
न च क्षरति तेभ्यः स शश्वच्चैवाप्नुते महत् ।
सुवर्णमक्षयं दत्त्वा लोकानाप्नोति पुष्कलान् ॥

meaning.en: He does not fall from them, and he always gains greatness. By giving imperishable gold he reaches ample worlds.

verses.text:
यस्तु संजनयित्वाग्निमादित्योदयनं प्रति ।
दद्याद्वै व्रतमुद्दिश्य सर्वान्कामान्समश्नुते ॥

meaning.en: One who, having kindled a fire, gives toward sunrise with a vow in mind obtains all desires.

verses.text:
अग्निरित्येव तत्प्राहुः प्रदानं वै सुखावहम् ।
यथेष्टगुणसंपन्नं प्रवर्तकमिति स्मृतम् ॥

meaning.en: They say it is called Agni; the gift brings happiness, is endowed with whatever good qualities are wished, and is remembered as a prompter.

verses.text: भीष्म उवाच

meaning.en: Bhishma said:

verses.text:
इत्युक्तः स वसिष्ठेन जामदग्न्यः प्रतापवान् ।
ददौ सुवर्णं विप्रेभ्यो व्यमुच्यत च किल्बिषात् ॥

meaning.en: Thus addressed by Vasishtha, the mighty son of Jamadagni gave gold to brahmins and was freed from sin.

verses.text:
एतत्ते सर्वमाख्यातं सुवर्णस्य महीपते ।
प्रदानस्य फलं चैव जन्म चाग्न्यमनुत्तमम् ॥

meaning.en: All this has been told to you, lord of the earth, about gold, the fruit of giving it, and its unsurpassed origin from Agni.

verses.text:
तस्मात्त्वमपि विप्रेभ्यः प्रयच्छ कनकं बहु ।
ददत्सुवर्णं नृपते किल्बिषाद्विप्रमोक्ष्यसि ॥

meaning.en: Therefore you too should give much gold to brahmins. By giving gold, king, you will be freed from sin.
